MC1_search.what: the formal D1 full search (forward baseline stage1_init.d1_target_aware.scored_v1@v1) with one profile, calib.s0m_mix_2x@v1; commit k=1; materialize and identify the Top-1; secure it (relay upload + dev-box read-back by sha256) and the search evidence (journal, states.jsonl, telemetry, search_record)

network_volume.why: the search's durable state: 34 states, about 96.0 GB at the historical per-level state sizes, plus the Top-1 and the journal; retired under AGENTS.md 2.5 once the Top-1 and the evidence are durable elsewhere

MC1_search._cap: the bound is DEPTH in every one of the 16 tree positions it can occupy; history never put it below level 3 (feasibility :: compute.model.historical_depth_fraction_by_level)

MC2_recovery_and_evaluation.what: two units, Mix-Augmented-s20260726 and Mix-Augmented-s20260801: D4-Augmented's recovery from the MC1 Top-1 (3,702 optimizer steps on the 5,923,021-token merged set), then every item of eval-set-1 under nucleus_v1; nothing of D4-Augmented is retrained or re-evaluated

MC2_recovery_and_evaluation.storage: am5m373kuq (30 GB): the four D4 checkpoints (9.54 GB) stay; the two new fp32 checkpoints add 4.77 GB; peak about 24.0 GB during the second training (one final checkpoint + one live save point pair + evaluation evidence), inside the provider's 30 GB

entry_4x.criterion: enter 4x only on one of two preregistered results of M: (a) GO -- a dose follow-up asks whether more of the mixed calibration helps further; (b) REVERSED on the deduction axis (the one axis where D4-Augmented is off the floor) -- 2x's realized volume is 0.70x of base_d4's, so a harm at 2x confounds composition with less calibration, and 4x (1.32x base_d4) separates them. NO_GO, INCONCLUSIVE and NOT_RESOLVED do not enter 4x: an interval that crosses a SESOI is a power limit, not a volume question, and NO_GO excludes a meaningful effect of the composition at 2x
not_a_criterion: a lower state-evaluation or step-0 KL at 4x
more rule families or a second episode by themselves

would_cost.plus: a second MC2 recovery and evaluation (expected $10.91)
